sn35.22:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– yo bhikkhave, rūpānaṃ uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn35.22:1.6: yo dhammānaṃ uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn35.22:2.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave, rūpānaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo.
sn35.22:2.6: yo dhammānaṃ nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthagamoti.
